name: mpdantic
description: Audits and repairs a music library for MPD: output buffer sizing by RAM, .mpdignore management, CUE sheet repair, playlist rebasing, tag validation. Rust core, thin Node shell.
author: Just a Nerd

volumio_info.details: Pedantic about your library, so MPD does not choke on it. Audits and repairs a music library for MPD, folder by folder, from its own management page.
volumio_info.changelog: 0.1.1 Second test cut: the core writes files owned by another user (music copied over the network); MP3s with junk before the first frame written; the tag editor file by file; the Volumio tab checking and repairing Volumio's playlists, favourites and queue; the ignore file edited by hand; the player report on a System tab; the buttons organised by role; third-party notices in the zip.
